blinding_guess.why: The package ships its own rviz_rendering::MeshShape (copied from ros2/rviz per the TODO at mesh_shape.hpp:40) that subclasses rviz_rendering::Shape and reaches directly into its non-public members entity_, material_, material_name_, offset_node_, scene_manager_ and into the material named by material_name_ (looked up without a resource-group argument). That coupling breaks if the foxy rviz_rendering Shape renames, moves, or changes the naming or resource group of these members or of its Shape<N>Material material, but the rviz_rendering headers are not an allowed source, so I cannot tell whether they match at this revision.
